name: Shida Sarina
source:
Area: Yamanashi Prefecture

A tall girl who has a complex over her height, especially after she got turned down after confessing her love to her classmate. She is also called the "human mountain" at school. Sarina's hobby is climbing and she often climbs the mountains all alone. She also likes fancy clothes, but thinks they do not fit her because she's not cute enough and her breasts are way too big.
